why: Checkpoint policy for long-living orchestrating sessions (phase 0). Values from docs/COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md (Recommended values table; source ids in brackets). W = model context window; thresholds are min(pct of W, absolute cap).

warn.why: min(55% W, 150k): 150k is Anthropic's server-compaction default trigger [A5]; quality loss is measurable well below the window limit [R1, R2]. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Warn.

checkpoint.why: min(70% W, 200k): results above 256k are weak and uneven (MRCR 512k-1M 32-76%) [R4]; Codex's old effective window was 258k [O3]. A 200k window binds on the %, a 1M window on the cap. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Checkpoint.

force.why: min(85% W, 300k, price cliff - margin): leaves room for the handoff on 200k windows. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Hard / forced restart.

price_cliff_tokens.why: Per-model input-price cliffs for API-billed sessions: OpenAI API >272k is 2x input [O1], Haiku 5.5 API >100k is 5x [A2]. Subscription sessions have none and are not listed. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Hard / forced restart.

price_cliff_margin_tokens.why: force <= cliff - 10k so the handoff turn itself stays under the cliff. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Hard / forced restart.

velocity.why: Checkpoint now if current + 2 x mean growth of the last 3 turns >= force, or one turn adds >= 10% of W: a single large read can jump past the threshold between checks (inferred rule). COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Velocity rule.

idle_cache_ttl_s.why: At >= warn, checkpoint at the turn boundary; idle longer than the cache TTL at >= warn means the next turn re-reads cold, so checkpoint before resuming. TTL 5 min API key / 1 h subscription on Claude [A3], 30 min default on OpenAI [O2]. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Idle-boundary rule.

self_handoff_deadline_s.why: 4 min after the current tool call ends, forced at 6 min: ~8k output tokens with thinking take ~2-3 min (estimate). COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Handoff deadline.

time_based_timer.why: No hard timer: no primary evidence for a time-based effect; the '35-minute' claim is unverified [R3]. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Time-based refresh.

handoff_total_tokens.why: <= 16k, about 8% of the 200k checkpoint: Claude Code re-injects <= 5 files at <= 5k each and <= 25k of skills [A7]; Codex keeps ~20k of user messages [O4]. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Total handoff budget.

section_budgets.why: Per-section caps (not allocations; they sum to 16.2k, the total budget trims excerpts, files, decisions, recency pin in that order): goal 400 (one paragraph), rules 1500 verbatim [O4], decisions 1500 [A6], in-flight 2000 [A6], files 800 [A7, M1], excerpts 6000 [A6], recency pin <= 4000 [M1]. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Goal .. Recency pin.

goal_prompts.why: Goal is 400 tokens, one paragraph: the latest user prompt verbatim; the earlier ones go to the recency pin. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Goal.

recency_pin.why: Last 3 user turns verbatim (those not already in Goal) plus the last 2 tool calls raw, so the model's style and behaviour carry over [M1]. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Recency pin.

files_max.why: Path plus one line each, <= 40 files: the agent can re-read files, only paths are needed [A7, M1]. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Files touched.

recency_window_messages.why: Phase 0 design, not in the research: in-flight identifiers are scanned in, and excerpts get a recency bonus for, the last 8 messages.

recency_bonus.why: Phase 0 design, not in the research: bonus larger than one shared goal word (+3), smaller than two, so recent context wins ties.

chars_per_token.why: Token estimate = ceil(chars / chars_per_token): Claude's tokenizer averages ~2.5 chars/token [A1], GPT ~4; unknown formats use the conservative (larger) Claude estimate. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Characters versus tokens.

excerpt_tool_result_chars.why: Tool results in handoff excerpts are shown head + tail with the original char count; the full result can be re-run or re-read (reversible compaction [M1]). Small because excerpts are evidence pointers. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Tool-result truncation.

excerpt_message_truncation_chars.why: Phase 0 design, not in the research: one long message cannot take the whole excerpt budget.

provider_tool_result_cap_tokens.why: For phase 1 (provider side), not used by the handoff: 8k tokens per result, head + tail, full output to a file; Codex's tuning guides use 8k [O4], reversible compaction [M1]. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Tool-result truncation.

circuit_breaker.why: 2 forced restarts in 30 min, or a fresh session that opens above 50% of the checkpoint threshold: stop and escalate to the owner, no auto restart; a too-big handoff or a loop means restarts stop helping. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Circuit breaker.

pruning.why: Phase 1 tool-result pruning starts at min(100k, 40% W), keeps the last 4 results, prunes only if >= 20k tokens are freed: Anthropic's clear_tool_uses default and clear_at_least so a cache break pays for itself [A4, A6]. Phase 1's tables/compaction-prune.json must read these values from here, not copy them. COMPACTION-THRESHOLDS.md, Tool-result pruning.
